200.answer:
To remove an account from MonBell:
1. Go to bell.ca using a web browser.
2. Log in with your MonBell username and password.
3. Go to "Mon profil", then "Profil de la facturation".
4. Select the bill with the account you want to remove, then click "Supprimer cette facture" and "Continuer".
